What is the minimum order quantity for this part?

We supply in bulk. The minimum run is 10,000 pieces per part number, per compound, or quoted against the part where geometry or tooling makes that unrealistic. Prototype and first-article lots sit outside the minimum.
Can you match a competitor specification or reverse-engineer an existing part?

Yes. Send the old seal, the medium and both temperatures. If the incumbent seal is FKM, tell us why it was chosen — often the answer is a peak the shaft only sees at shutdown, and sometimes AEM at half the price covers it.
What file formats do you accept for drawings?

PDF, DWG, DXF and STEP — but a drawing is often unnecessary. Shaft diameter, housing bore, width, type A or AS, plus the medium and both temperatures is a complete specification. Name the FKM grade if your drawing calls one out.
Do you provide material test reports with each shipment?

Yes. Material test reports, dimensional inspection sheets and a certificate of conformance ship with every consignment. Hardness, tensile to ASTM D412 and compression set to ASTM D395 Method B are tested in-house, with dimensions checked against DIN 3760. Post-cure is recorded on the batch record, since it is what makes the temperature rating real.
What are your payment and delivery terms for international orders?

TT and LC accepted, discussed per order. Ex-works Nashik or FOB Nhava Sheva. Commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin are issued with every consignment. Seals are packed to protect the sealing lip.
